vision.title: Our Vision & Mission
vision.description: At Yumetoki Education, we are driven by a clear vision and mission to transform education through personalized learning.
vision.missionText: To create the best learning experience for each student through personalized teaching methods, inspire their learning potential, and cultivate a passion for lifelong learning.
vision.visionText: To become the most trusted provider of personalized educational services in Taiwan, helping students achieve success in their academic and personal lives.
vision.valuesText: Personalized attention, high-quality teaching, continuous innovation, integrity and respect, lifelong learning.

history.title: Our History
history.description: The journey of Yumetoki Education from its founding to the present day, marked by continuous growth and commitment to educational excellence.
